cards.finding: Krillin's closed eyes, orange gi, rear hand and tail agree with the original. The retained source omits the mouth/nose at the left edge, whereas the original includes the face; this remains an inherited framing limitation, not a full-framing pass.
Roshi's glasses, beard, green shirt, mug and five-digit open hand match the original scene. Eyes and mouth are obscured; fine facial comparison is not applicable.

Krillin's wide happy mouth, closed rounded eyes, buns and hands agree with the original. The retained composition shows less of the turtle and head margin than the original; inherited framing limitation recorded.
Goku's tightly closed eyes, clenched teeth, bruises, bare shoulder and foreground hand are compatible with the original. Fine finger detail remains limited by scan resolution.

Direct enlarged comparison confirms clenched teeth, strained sideways eyes, raised arms, wristband and red lighting. The original shows more of the upper fist than the retained source; inherited framing limitation recorded.

Original scan compared: Raditz's kick across rear-facing Goku, scouter, armor and raised fist match. The prior localized repair retains the complete rounded white boot toe. Tiny original faces do not resolve exact teeth/tongue/pupil details.
User-approved replacement retained. Goku's closed-mouth slight smile, fist and torn orange/blue gi are compatible with the original scene.

Original and enlarged retained artwork inspected. Rear-facing Goku reaches with two arms and two skin-toned open hands toward an energy field. A purple angular form overlaps below the lower wrist and reads as floating debris; the small original does not resolve this overlap precisely. No speculative anatomy edit.
Piccolo's shielding arm, turban/cape, purple gi, bent legs, pink energy streaks and debris are compatible with the original. Eyes are obscured; fine facial details are unresolved.
Raditz's closed asymmetric smirk, scouter and strongly foreshortened open hands agree with the original composition. Five-digit foreground hand remains coherent.

Retained artwork reviewed: Raditz foreground dive, bared teeth, flared hair and side figures are coherent. Existing side-figure and shoe-edge crop limits remain. Original scan could not be retrieved; exact original fidelity is unresolved.
Retained artwork reviewed: Raditz kneeling at a crater, hand on knee, hanging fist, closed firm mouth, scouter and armor are coherent. Full lower fist remains visible. Original scan unavailable.
Retained Goku strained side gaze, clenched teeth, scratches, torn gi and foreshortened shoulder/arm inspected. No new material obstruction. Original scan unavailable.

User-approved newer replacement retained: Goku focused eyes, closed mouth, orange/blue gi and raised/open arms. Existing source-edge hand crops remain. Original scan unavailable for a fresh direct comparison.

Masked Arlian figure retains blue lenses, segmented purple/white armor and fist. Ordinary facial expression is not applicable; source antenna and lowest fist-edge crop limitations remain. Original scan unavailable.
Retained Goku diagonal flying pose, clenched teeth, near-head fist, bent legs and red/pink energy lighting inspected. Visible limbs are connected and scene is present. Original scan unavailable.
Retained Raditz forward flying pose, tooth-showing grin, green scouter, flared hair and shoulder armor inspected. Existing top/side crops remain. Original scan unavailable.
Retained close-up clenched fist and blue wristband inspected: four curled fingers and crossing thumb are coherent, with complete fist outline. No face is present. Original scan unavailable.
Retained Roshi sunglasses/beard and turtle open mouth/tongue inspected. Existing Roshi top and turtle right-edge crops remain. Original scan unavailable.

Retained Raditz close-up, narrowed visible eye, closed downturned mouth, scouter and small object pinched between thumb/index finger inspected. Earlier review misnamed the character Vegeta; this review corrects that identification. Original scan unavailable.
